item.title: Comcast touts low-latency advantage with 'RealTime4K'
item.description: Comcast said its streaming of Super Bowl LX in 'RealTime4K' delivered the game about 17 seconds behind the live action, on par with over-the-air broadcasts and better than several virtual MVPDs.

item.title: The 'new' Harmonic prepares to cut the video cord
item.description: Harmonic is set to become a 'pure-play broadband leader' amid the sale of its video business to MediaKind. With a focus on FTTP and DOCSIS, Harmonic also aims to diversify its business well beyond Comcast and Charter.

item.title: Carr urges broadcasters to air 'patriotic, pro-America programming' to support US milestone
item.description: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr's Pledge America Campaign calls on broadcasters to run pro-America programming in support of US's 250th. Such programming could include patriotic PSAs and short segments highlighting US history and civic education, and starting each broadcast day with the Star Spangled Banner or Pledge of Allegiance. #pressrelease

item.title: Orange seeks to harness data for hyper-personalization, adtech
item.description: During a roundtable with press and analysts, Orange's CFO Laurent Martinez shared detail on areas of the company's new strategy like hyper-personalization and adtech.

item.title: KDDI and Nokia advance data security with quantum-safe transport
item.description: KDDI and Nokia successfully demonstrated quantum-safe optical transport capabilities at KDDI's new Sakai Data Center in Osaka, Japan.

item.title: Billing clarity matters more than the critics think (and less than we said)
item.description: Recon Analytics' Roger Entner takes issue with a column from Omdia's James Crawshaw, who took issue with an earlier column from Recon Analytics. The debate takes on the relevance of bill clarity as a driver of telco customer churn.

item.title: Eurobites: Europe's Big Five edge closer
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Altice France debt pile has grown, says FT; Ericsson, Ookla go network slice testing; Eutelsat agrees maritime deal.

item.title: Chorus fiber plan on backburner over lack of government funding
item.description: New Zealand wholesaler Chorus cites government's unwillingness to co-invest in its rural fiber scheme as reason for deprioritizing fiber rollout.

item.title: Castanet tees up 5G Broadcast market trials
item.description: Castanet, a newcomer that's planning to build a national 5G Broadcast network with low-power TV stations, plans to field test its platform in at least three markets this year.

item.title: Linux Foundation showcases open collaboration across AI, 5G, and cloud-native telco at MWC Barcelona 2026
item.description: Arpit Joshipura speaking at the Agentic AI Summit and 5G Futures Summit as CAMARA, Sylva and LF Education activate on the ground. #pressrelease
